evidence.quote:
An AI chip startup has raised $1 billion in financing as investors continue to pour money into companies looking to challenge Nvidia .
SambaNova is now valued at $11 billion thanks to the financing, which was led by General Atlantic along with participation from Seligman Ventures, T. Rowe Price and Capital Group.
evidence.one_line: SambaNova raised $1 billion in financing, bringing its valuation to $11 billion, in a round led by General Atlantic with participation from Seligman Ventures, T. Rowe Price and Capital Group.
evidence.speaker: CNBC

evidence.quote: On Wednesday, JPMorgan Chase said it would deploy SambaNova's systems for "on-prem inference in our demanding enterprise AI workloads."

evidence.quote: "We're scaling the business really, really fast, and so the capital allows us to really accelerate the deployments of the racks that customers really want," he said.

evidence.speaker: Rodrigo Liang, speaking to CNBC at the Raise AI summit in Paris
